# Mega Power Engineering & Trading

> Singapore supplier of automotive air-conditioning and cooling parts since 1989, for workshops, overseas buyers and parts suppliers. Four branches in Singapore. Main line +65 6842 3389, enquiry@megapower.com.sg. Enquiry-based: no public prices.
